mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO sys_school_department (id, parent_id, name, name_en, order_num, department_leader) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.parentId}, #{item.name}, #{item.nameEn}, #{item.order}, #{item.departmentLeader})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE parent_id = VALUES(parent_id), name = VALUES(name), name_en = VALUES(name_en), order_num = VALUES(order_num), department_leader = VALUES(department_leader)
mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_id, name, name_en, order_num, department_leader FROM sys_school_department WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, parent_id, name, name_en, order_num, department_leader FROM sys_school_department ORDER BY parent_id, order_num
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_school_department SET parent_id = #{parentId}, name = #{name}, name_en = #{nameEn}, order_num = #{order}, department_leader = #{departmentLeader} WHERE id = #{id}
